paras.html: There are nights when the basketball seems as big as a beach ball and everything finds the bottom of the net. Sunday afternoon in Jacksonville wasn't one of those nights for the Florida Gators.

paras.text: Sitting courtside at VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena, I watched Florida
paras.html: Sitting courtside at VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena, I watched Florida stumble through a frustrating 82-76 overtime exhibition loss to Baylor. And while exhibition games don't count in the standings, they can tell you plenty about what needs fixing before the real season begins.
